meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将已有小说反向解析为标准写作项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有写好的小说想纳入结构化写作流程
copy.tagline_en: Reverse-import existing novels into a standard writing project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an existing novel to bring into a structured writing workflow

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把你已经写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析成标准项目目录结构，包括设定、大纲、正文、追踪等，方便你接着续写。
howto.when: 当你提到“/story-import”、“导入小说”、“反向解析”、“导入”或“把我的书导进来”时触发。

say.text: 导入我写了一半的小说，文件路径是 /home/user/novel.txt。
say.note: Claude 会开始分析并生成项目结构。

say.text: 反向解析这本完本小说，帮我建好续写工程。
say.note: Claude 会先确认信息，然后深度分析并迁移结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can reverse-parse your existing novel (draft or complete) into a standard project directory structure, including settings, outline, text, tracking, etc., so you can continue writing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "/story-import", "import novel", "reverse parse", "import", or "bring my book in".

say_en.note: Claude will start analyzing and generating the project structure.

say_en.text: Reverse parse this completed novel and build a continuation project.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm info, then deep-analyze and migrate structure.
